text:
Ava (product): quick design review of compliance settings page — I pushed a new figma frame with the region selector and KMS badge changes, can folks skim?
Ryan (design): saw it. main thing i noticed: the KMS label currently reads "Key managed by: Redwood" vs "Customer-managed key" — feels ambiguous. suggest: "Redwood-managed key (recommended)" and "Bring your own key (KMS)"
Maya (eng): +1 on clearer phrasing. also the dropdown has country flags, which look nice but they're decorative; we need alt text/aria-hidden so screen readers don't read "flag of us" for every option
Jon (security): on BYOK copy — we should surface the enforcement impact: brief line like: "Using your KMS disables Redwood access to plaintext; make sure your rotation policy is compatible". keeps users aware.
Leah (ux): small accessibility nit: the retention toggle uses green text on a light green bg — contrast is ~2.4:1 which fails AA. recommend darker text or solid outline.
Ava (product): good catch. can we standardize badge colors to our status tokens? green=ok, amber=warn, grey=not-configured. Leah — can you propose values?
Leah (ux): proposing: bg #F0FFF4 / text #044E1A for success, #FFF8E6 / #7A4F00 for warn, #F3F4F6 / #111827 for neutral. also add focus ring to badges for keyboard users.
Maya (eng): one implementation concern: flags in select cause reflow on mobile, maybe remove flags from small viewports. we can keep them on desktop.
Ryan (design): another copy tweak for retention: current label "Retention: 90 days" vs suggestion "Audit logs retained for 90 days" — more explicit. and tooltip: "After this period logs are permanently deleted" (avoid vague "may be purged").
Jon (security): audit log filter defaults — currently shows "All actions". prefer default to "Admin actions" for privacy-conscious orgs? open to debate.
Ava (product): I'd rather keep conservative default as All, but surface a bolding on sensitive events and a quick toggle to "Show sensitive only" so users notice privacy scope.
Leah (ux): accessibility for the region selector — add aria-label="Deployment region" and ensure items have role=option and are keyboard reachable. also add live region announcement when region changes: "Region switched to europe-west1, requests may route to different data centers"
Maya (eng): will do. FYI KMS dropdown needs an extra API flag to indicate "customer_key_present" for the UI to switch copy. I'll add it to the spec.
Ryan (design): microcopy suggestion for KMS key status chips: instead of "Enabled" use "Encryption in use" and for non-configured "No customer key configured" — clearer for non-security folks.
Jon (security): add a small lock icon next to the audit export button and change the tooltip to "Exports are logged and require admin permission". helps with compliance audits.
Ava (product): love that. last thing — can we get a quick a11y pass checklist before next release? Leah + Maya can pair and I can add a small note in release notes.
Leah (ux): I can do a checklist: contrast, focus order, aria-labels, live region messages, keyboard tests. will ping once done.
Maya (eng): pairing ok. will schedule 30m after sprint planning.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for staging at 2024-11-02T14:22:00Z :rocket:
Ava (product): thanks team! i'll update the figma with the exact copy and the retention tooltip sentence. tagging follow-ups: @Maya please add the api flag, @Leah please share checklist. :thumbsup:
